environment.description: Go WebSocket service deployed on a bare EC2 instance (m5.large) in a public subnet with a public IP. Security group allows inbound TCP 8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No load balancer, no WAF, no reverse proxy. The service is directly internet-facing. Uploaded files are served back via the built-in file server at /files/ with no Content-Disposition headers forced.
